text:
maya: Quick thread to finalize ThroughputPlus pricing + pilot constraints. Customer asks keep coming: sustained 2.5x throughput, occasional 5x bursts, per-route caps, and predictable overage math. What do we ship for pilot vs GA?

derek: From infra: sustainable 2.5x requires reserved pools + per-tenant QoS. We should carve: base (no commit), ThroughputPlus-Std (2x, soft burst), ThroughputPlus-Pro (2.5x + burst credits). Technical knobs: per-route cap, tenant-level hard cap, cluster-level policing. Suggest sample knobs: ```
per_tenant_hard_qps=4000
per_tenant_soft_qps=8000
burst_window_sec=300
burst_credits_month=100000
```
Telemetry: tp.qps, tp.burst_credits_used, tp.cluster_throttle.

ravi: Sales perspective: customers love simple math. Two things matter: predictable price and clear burst consumption. Propose pricing model: flat per-month for capacity + token-equivalent overage. Example (pilot):
```
ThroughputPlus-Std: $2,000/mo + $0.08 per 1k tokens overage
ThroughputPlus-Pro: $5,000/mo + $0.05 per 1k tokens overage, 100k burst credits included
```
Pilot discounts: 25% month 1 for two pilot customers.

ana-legal: Flagging contract language: "burst credits" must be defined (what counts as a credit), non-transferable, and not a guarantee of availability. Add force-majeure/mitigation clause for platform stability. Any SLA uplift (latency/uptime) tied to credits needs legal review.

maya: Good call. For pilot we can keep SLAs unchanged and market ThroughputPlus as "priority routing" not a separate uptime SLA. Legal review only if customer explicitly requires SLA changes.

derek: Operational note: if many tenants burst simultaneously, cluster burst pool could be exhausted quickly. We need emergency fallback to per-route throttling and an overflow policy to redirect to standard model variant. Also add circuit-breaker metrics and an admin kill-switch.

billing-bot: REMINDER: Billing system needs line-item: "ThroughputPlus (Std/Pro)", meter: burst_credits_used, overage_rate. Tag charges with commit_id when pilot discount applies.

ravi: Sales playbook items: negotiable levers = commit term (3/12 months), included burst credits, and priority in capacity queue. Non-negotiable = unlimited burst, cross-tenant isolation promises.

maya: Launch criteria (pilot -> GA): 1) 2 pilot customers onboarded and billed, 2) console UI for burst balance + meter, 3) telemetry + alerting + 30d logs, 4) legal-approved standard T&C clause, 5) runbook for cross-tenant bursts. Target pilot in 4 weeks.

derek: I'll scope engineering: feature flag gating, quota UI hooks, meter events, and cluster policing. ETA for initial staging rollout: 2 weeks.

ci-bot: NOTE: feature-flag "throughputplus" enabled in staging; integration tests queued.

maya: Emily/Sales please lock pilot commitments by EOW. I'll draft a one-pager pricing sheet and include the sample numbers above. If no objections to the pilot pricing in 24h I'll hand to legal.

ana-legal: Acknowledged. I'll prep standard burst clause and a short checklist for any SLA exceptions.

ravi: Locking AcmeX and PixelSoft for pilot outreach today. Will update channel.

maya: Thanks everyone ":sparkles:" — final PRD + pricing sheet tomorrow. If anyone has alternate price bands or wants to propose a compute-unit conversion for burst credits speak now.
